User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a prioritized list of Agentforce NBA recommendations so that I can take the highest-impact actions first each day.
Acceptance Criteria: Queue displays all pending NBA actions sorted by AI priority score | Each card shows: VIP name · segment · tier · action type · recommended message · urgency badge | Queue count visible in section header | Empty state shown when no actions pending

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want each NBA card labeled with an action type (Retention / Upsell / Reactivation / Loyalty Milestone / Check-In / RG Signal) so that I can mentally triage my queue at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria: Action type badge renders on each card | Color-coded by type: Retention=amber · Upsell=green · Reactivation=blue · Loyalty=purple · Check-In=gray · RG Signal=red | Badge consistent with SLDS pill style

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want each NBA card to show the VIP context and action buttons without requiring me to expand so that I can act faster and reduce clicks.
Acceptance Criteria: All NBA card content visible by default: category tag · VIP name · description · meta (tier/segment/GGR/days) · action buttons | No expand/collapse toggle | Action buttons always inline on card | Card collapses only on Defer or dismiss action

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to log a contact directly from the NBA card so that I can close the action without navigating away from the queue.
Acceptance Criteria: Log Contact button on each NBA card | Clicking opens log contact modal pre-filled with VIP name and action context | Submission marks card as actioned and removes from queue | Last Contact date updates on VIP record

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to dismiss an NBA recommendation with a reason so that the queue stays clean and Agentforce can learn from my override.
Acceptance Criteria: Dismiss option available on each card (overflow menu or explicit button) | Dismiss requires selecting a reason: Not Relevant · Already Handled · Timing Not Right · Other | Dismissed cards removed from active queue | Dismissals logged for Agentforce feedback loop

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want RG Signal NBA actions visually distinguished and surfaced at the top of the queue so that I never miss a responsible gambling flag.
Acceptance Criteria: RG Signal cards: red border + urgent badge + pinned to top of queue | Includes: player context + AI-generated welfare check recommendation | Dismissing an RG card requires additional confirmation step

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see a summary of my team's pending NBA actions across all KAMs so that I can identify who is falling behind on Agentforce recommendations.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager view shows: total pending actions by KAM + actions overdue (>24h) | Drill-down to individual KAM queue | Filter by action type

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a suggested contact window on each NBA card so that I know when the action is most likely to be effective.
Acceptance Criteria: Contact window label visible: e.g. 'Act within 4h' · 'Today' · 'This week' | Window highlighted in amber when approaching expiry | Expired windows shown with overdue badge

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see my Weekly Priority Contacts list so that I know exactly which VIPs I need to reach out to this week.
Acceptance Criteria: WPC list populates at start of each week | Each entry shows: VIP name · segment · tier · days since last contact · WPC status (Pending / In Progress / Complete) | List sorted by urgency (most overdue first)

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to mark a WPC item complete by logging a contact so that my weekly progress is tracked accurately.
Acceptance Criteria: Log Contact button on each WPC row | Logging contact updates status to Complete with timestamp | Completed rows visually distinguished (green badge) | Last Contact date updates on VIP master record

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to be alerted when WPC items are approaching or past their weekly deadline so that I don't miss critical contacts.
Acceptance Criteria: Overdue WPC items flagged with red badge | System alert/notification fires when WPC deadline is within 24h | Overdue state persists until contact is logged

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see my outstanding tasks alongside WPC contacts so that I have a single prioritized to-do list for the day.
Acceptance Criteria: Tasks tab shows all open tasks: type · VIP name · due date · status | Tasks filterable by type (Contact / Bonus / Follow-Up / Admin) | Completed tasks collapsible

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to filter my task list by status (Pending / Done) or type so that I can focus on what needs attention now.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter tabs: All · Tasks Only · WPC Only · Pending · Done | Filter selection persists during session | Count badge updates to reflect filtered set

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see WPC completion rates across my team so that I can hold KAMs accountable and identify support needs.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager dashboard shows: % WPC complete by KAM for current week | Red/amber/green status indicators | Drill-down to individual KAM's list

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a contact log modal pre-populated with the VIP's details so that logging is fast and consistent.
Acceptance Criteria: Modal fields: Contact Type (picklist) · Date/Time (auto-filled) · Notes (free text) · Outcome (picklist) | VIP name pre-filled from row | Submission closes modal and updates row status

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see all VIPs currently in their 6-week onboarding window so that I can track their progress and take timely actions.
Acceptance Criteria: New VIPs tab shows players within 6-week window | Each row: VIP name · segment · onboarding start date · current week (Wk 1–6) · KYC status · survey status | Sorted by onboarding week ascending (newest first) | VIPs with no logged contact within 3 days of joining show a ⚠ warning flag on their row | Flag tooltip reads 'No contact logged — target is within 3 days of join'

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see which week of onboarding each new VIP is in so that I know which milestone actions are due.
Acceptance Criteria: Week number badge visible on each onboarding row (Wk 1–Wk 6) | Week 5–6 highlighted in amber as approaching end of window | Tooltip or inline guidance on what action is expected each week

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to send a welcome survey to a new VIP directly from the onboarding tracker so that I can capture their preferences early.
Acceptance Criteria: Send Survey button on each onboarding row | Clicking triggers survey send and updates row to 'Survey Sent' state | Button disabled after send to prevent duplicates | Timestamp of send recorded

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see each new VIP's KYC status so that I know if there are verification blockers before I can fully activate them.
Acceptance Criteria: KYC status displays as badge: Pending / Verified / Failed | Failed KYC highlighted in red | KAM cannot initiate certain bonus actions until KYC is Verified

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see VIPs flagged as churn or demotion risks so that I can prioritize retention outreach before it's too late.
Acceptance Criteria: Churn/Demotion tab shows at-risk VIPs | Each row: name · segment · tier · churn risk level (High/Medium/Low) · key signal · recommended action | Sorted by risk level descending

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to initiate a retention action for a churning VIP directly from the offboarding tracker so that I can act immediately.
Acceptance Criteria: Retain button on each churn row | Opens action picker: Log Contact / Send Bonus / Escalate to Manager | Selected action logged against VIP record | Row status updates to reflect action taken

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to initiate a demotion workflow for a VIP who no longer meets tier criteria so that the process is documented and compliant.
Acceptance Criteria: Demote button on each churn row | Clicking opens demotion confirmation modal: VIP name + demotion reason picklist + impact summary | Confirming triggers downstream workflow: compliance notification + player notification + record update | Demotion reason required before confirm is enabled

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to review and approve demotion requests before they are finalized so that we maintain consistent standards.
Acceptance Criteria: Demotion requests appear in manager approval queue | Manager can: Approve / Reject / Request More Info | Approved demotions trigger final workflow execution | Rejected demotions notify the originating KAM with reason

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see my full VIP book sorted by priority then by days since last contact so that I always lead with my most valuable players and catch anyone overdue.
Acceptance Criteria: Tracker displays all VIPs in two sections: (1) Priority Book — top 10% by GGR (SBK) or NGR (CAS), sorted by days overdue; (2) Full Book — remaining VIPs, sorted by days overdue | Section headers clearly label each group with VIP count | Color-coded status: ≤14d=green / 15–29d=amber / 30d+=red | Filter and sort apply within each section

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to filter the contact tracker by cadence status so that I can focus on overdue contacts across my full book or priority book only.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter tabs: All · In Cadence · Due Soon · Overdue | Filters apply across both Priority Book and Full Book sections | Empty section hidden when filter produces no matches in that group | Count badge per tab reflects filtered total

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to send an email or SMS to a VIP and log a contact directly from the tracker row so that I can act on urgency without navigating away.
Acceptance Criteria: Email button and SMS button visible on each tracker row | Clicking Email opens email compose flow pre-filled with VIP name and contact details | Clicking SMS opens SMS compose flow | Log Contact option available in ⋮ overflow menu alongside View Contact Record | All actions update Last Contact date and recalculate cadence status in real time

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the contact log modal to capture contact type, notes, and outcome so that the record is meaningful for future reference.
Acceptance Criteria: Modal fields: Contact Type (Call / Email / Text / In-Person / Event) · Date/Time · Notes · Outcome | All fields except Notes are required | Submission triggers toast confirmation

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see a summary of my team's contact cadence health so that I can identify KAMs who are falling behind on player engagement.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager view: count of Overdue / Due Soon / In Cadence across team | Filter by individual KAM | Export option for weekly reporting

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see VIPs who have had unusually large single-session wins or losses so that I can respond with appropriate outreach quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Big Swings tab shows players with recent large swings | Each row: VIP name · segment · swing amount · direction (win/loss) · session count · % change vs avg stake | Sorted by magnitude descending | Refreshes on page load or manual refresh

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to log a welfare check directly from the Big Swings tab so that player wellbeing is documented when large losses are detected.
Acceptance Criteria: Welfare Check button on each Big Swings row | Clicking opens log contact modal with Contact Type pre-set to 'Welfare Check' | Submission logs activity and removes row from alert state | Welfare check note flagged in VIP record

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see VIPs with pending or declined withdrawal requests so that I can escalate or assist before they become frustrated.
Acceptance Criteria: Payment Alerts tab shows: VIP name · withdrawal amount · status (Pending/Declined) · decline count · days pending | Declined rows highlighted in red | Sorted by decline count descending | NOTE: Data readiness pending (3rd-party source) — backlog until AWS Agent integration confirmed

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to escalate a payment issue to the Payments Ops team directly from the console so that I don't have to leave the platform to raise a case.
Acceptance Criteria: Escalate button on each payment alert row | Clicking triggers escalation workflow with SLA notification (4h response) | Row updates to 'Escalated' state with timestamp | Toast confirmation shown

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see VIPs on extended losing streaks so that I can proactively reach out with support or a retention offer.
Acceptance Criteria: Losing Streaks tab shows: VIP name · consecutive losing sessions · net loss · last session date | Threshold for inclusion: configurable (default: 3+ consecutive losing sessions) | Log Contact and Apply Bonus actions available per row

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a session-by-session wager history for a flagged VIP so that I can understand the pattern before reaching out.
Acceptance Criteria: Wager History modal opens from any RTA row | Shows: date · session duration · stakes · result per session | Scrollable history (last 10 sessions) | Apply Bonus CTA at bottom of modal

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see a count of unactioned RTA alerts across my team so that I know if critical situations are being ignored.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager header shows: total unactioned Big Swings + Payment Escalations + Losing Streak alerts | Red badge when any alert >4h unactioned | Drill-down to individual KAM's RTA view

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see upcoming FanDuel-hosted events so that I can plan VIP invitations in advance.
Acceptance Criteria: Events section shows cards for upcoming events | Each card: event name · date · venue · ticket availability count · ticket urgency indicator | Sorted by date ascending | Empty state when no upcoming events

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see when ticket availability is limited so that I can prioritize invitations before tickets run out.
Acceptance Criteria: Low availability indicator shows when tickets ≤25% remaining | Urgency badge: 'X tickets left' in amber | Card border highlights when critically low

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to send an event invitation to a VIP directly from the events section so that I can coordinate hospitality without leaving the console.
Acceptance Criteria: ⋮ 3-dot menu on each event row contains 'Invite VIP' action | Clicking opens invite flow: VIP selector + optional personal note | Submission updates event card to show invite sent count | Invite status recorded on VIP record | Actions TBD in refinement

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to manage the full guest list for an event so that I can track who has been invited, accepted, or declined.
Acceptance Criteria: ⋮ 3-dot menu on each event row contains 'Manage Event' action (hosted events) and 'View Event' action (invited/available events) | Manage Event modal shows: invited VIPs list · RSVP status per VIP (Sent / Accepted / Declined / No Response) · remaining ticket count | Add / Remove VIP from guest list within modal | Export guest list option

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to manage ticket assignment per event so that I can distribute tickets equitably across my VIP book.
Acceptance Criteria: Ticket Manager modal shows: total tickets · allocated · remaining | Assign tickets to specific VIPs | Unassign and reassign within the modal | Over-allocation blocked with inline error

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see all upcoming events and their invitation status across the team so that I can ensure high-priority VIPs are being engaged.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager view shows all events with: total invites sent · acceptances · tickets remaining | Filter by event or KAM | Flag events with low invite rate

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see all active and draft campaigns assigned to my book so that I can track what promotions are in flight.
Acceptance Criteria: Campaign section shows list of campaigns | Each row: name · type · status (Draft/Active/Completed) · target VIP count · send date · offer amount | Sorted by send date ascending

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to take contextual actions on each campaign row so that I can manage campaigns without leaving the console.
Acceptance Criteria: ⋮ 3-dot menu on each campaign row | Live/Scheduled campaigns: View Campaign · Add VIP · Duplicate | Draft campaigns: Edit Campaign · Preview · Delete Draft | Specific actions TBD in refinement | All actions accessible without navigating away

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to create a new campaign from a template so that I can run targeted promotions without needing marketing to build them.
Acceptance Criteria: New Campaign button opens modal | Fields: name · type (picklist) · offer amount · target VIPs (selector) · send date | Template options available for common campaign types | Submission creates Draft campaign pending approval

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to review and approve campaigns before they go live so that all promotions meet commercial and compliance standards.
Acceptance Criteria: Campaigns requiring approval appear in manager queue with Awaiting Sign-Off status | Manager can: Approve / Reject / Request Changes | Approved campaigns move to Active on send date | Rejected campaigns notify the KAM with reason

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see the details of an active campaign including which VIPs are targeted so that I can follow up personally with high-priority players.
Acceptance Criteria: Campaign Detail modal shows: full VIP target list · offer details · approval history · scheduled send time | Export target list option | Links to individual VIP records

User Story: As a KAM Director I want to see post-campaign performance metrics so that I can assess ROI and improve future campaigns.
Acceptance Criteria: Completed campaigns show: redemption rate · GGR lift vs. baseline · total offers issued · total cost | Comparison to similar past campaigns | Exportable performance report

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see VIPs with birthdays in the next 30 days so that I can plan personalized outreach in advance and not miss anyone.
Acceptance Criteria: Birthday list shows VIPs with birthdays in a rolling 30-day window | Content organized into weekly buckets (e.g. Sep 9–15 / Sep 16–22 / Sep 23–29 / Sep 30–Oct 8) | Week navigator: ‹ Prev / Next › allows KAM to step through weeks | Current week shown by default | Each row: name · segment · tier · birthday date (e.g. Today / Tomorrow / Sep 25) · offer status | Empty state when no birthdays in selected week

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to send a birthday offer to a VIP directly from the birthday list so that I can celebrate them quickly and personally.
Acceptance Criteria: ⋮ 3-dot menu on each birthday row contains 'Send Celebration' action | Clicking opens offer flow: offer type selector (Profit Boost / Bonus Credit / Gift) + offer amount + optional personal note | Submission marks row as 'Gift sent ✓' and logs activity on VIP record | Additional menu actions: View Profile · Log Note

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see which birthday offers have already been sent so that I don't accidentally double-send.
Acceptance Criteria: Sent rows display 'Gift sent ✓' in green text | 'Send Celebration' removed from ⋮ menu after send to prevent double-send | View Profile and Log Note remain available | Sent state persists within session

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see unreviewed VIP feedback so that I can stay on top of player sentiment without checking a separate system.
Acceptance Criteria: Unreviewed tab shows all feedback items not yet reviewed by KAM | Each item: VIP name · feedback excerpt · sentiment badge (Positive/Neutral/Negative) · date submitted | Sorted by date descending | Unreviewed count badge on section header

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to mark a feedback item as reviewed so that the unreviewed count stays accurate and I know where I left off.
Acceptance Criteria: Mark Reviewed button/toggle on each feedback item | Reviewed items move to All Feedback tab | Unreviewed count decrements | Action logged with timestamp

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to send a direct response to a VIP's feedback so that the player knows their voice has been heard.
Acceptance Criteria: Respond button on each feedback item | Opens Respond modal: feedback displayed read-only + response text area | Submission sends response to player via configured channel | Response logged on VIP record with timestamp

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see my full feedback history including reviewed items so that I can reference past sentiment when preparing for a player interaction.
Acceptance Criteria: All Feedback tab shows complete feedback history | Filterable by sentiment (Positive/Neutral/Negative) | Reviewed vs. Unreviewed status visible | Search by VIP name

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want feedback items color-coded by sentiment so that I can triage negative feedback first without reading every item.
Acceptance Criteria: Sentiment badge: Positive=green · Neutral=gray · Negative=red | Negative items surfaced first in default sort | Sentiment derived from Agentforce Einstein NLP classification

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a VIP's full feedback history in a side drawer so that I can understand their sentiment over time without leaving the pulse view.
Acceptance Criteria: History Drawer opens from any feedback item | Shows chronological list: date · excerpt · sentiment · reviewed status | Close drawer returns to pulse list

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to see aggregate sentiment scores across my team's VIP book so that I can identify systemic experience issues early.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager view: sentiment breakdown (% positive/neutral/negative) across all team feedback | Trend line over last 30/60/90 days | Flag KAMs with high negative feedback rates

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to expand a multi-segment VIP row to see their performance broken down by segment so that I can assess each product relationship independently.
Acceptance Criteria: VIPs assigned to multiple segments show an expand › chevron on their row | Clicking expands the row to show one child row per segment | Each child row shows: segment chip · tier · GGR L30 · last bonus issued · KAM assigned to that segment | Collapse returns to parent row | Expansion state persists during session

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want row-level actions on each VIP so that I can act on individual VIPs quickly from the table.
Acceptance Criteria: ⋮ actions menu on each VIP row contains: Log Contact · Bonus · View Profile | Actions visible on row hover | No bulk selection or bulk actions in MVP — individual row actions only | Each action opens the relevant modal pre-filled with VIP context

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a visual warning on any new VIP I haven't contacted within 3 days of joining so that I can prioritize first outreach before the window passes.
Acceptance Criteria: ⚠ flag displays on onboarding row when no contact logged and VIP joined >3 days ago | Flag rendered in amber on the VIP name or Joined column | Day count on Joined column color-coded: ≤3d=green · 4–7d=amber · >10d=red if no update | Tooltip on flag: 'No contact logged — past 3-day target'

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the primary action button on each onboarding row to reflect the VIP's current stage so that I always know exactly what to do next without having to think.
Acceptance Criteria: Action button label changes based on onboarding state: no contact yet=Send Survey · survey sent=Log Preferences · VIP past 3-day target with no contact=Urgent (red button) | Send Survey links to Outlook/email integration | Log Preferences links to contact record preferences section | Urgent links to contact record to initiate contact | ⋮ dropdown always contains: Follow Up / Contact and Mark Complete | Mark Complete removes row from queue with toast confirmation

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the Last Contact Tracker to paginate my full book of business so that I can review all VIPs (260–500) without the list becoming unmanageable.
Acceptance Criteria: Tracker paginates at 10 rows per page (configurable) | Pagination footer shows: 'Showing X–Y of Z VIPs' + ‹ Prev / Next › controls | Sort and filter state persists across page turns | Priority Book section always anchors to top of first page | Section headers persist across pages where the section spans multiple pages

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to send an email or SMS to a VIP directly from the tracker so that I can act on urgency in one click.
Acceptance Criteria: Email and SMS buttons visible on each tracker row | Clicking Email opens email compose with VIP pre-filled | Clicking SMS opens SMS compose | Both actions log a contact automatically on send | Last Contact date and cadence status update in real time after send

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to upload a CSV of Bonus Bet Credits so that I can process bulk credit assignments from the console without a manual workaround.
Acceptance Criteria: Upload zone accepts .csv files via drag-and-drop or file picker | CSV must contain: VIP ID · credit amount · expiry date | Validation runs on upload: invalid rows flagged with inline errors | Valid rows show preview before confirm | Confirm triggers credit processing workflow | Toast confirmation on success with count of records processed

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a history of Bonus Bet Credits issued to my VIPs so that I can track what has been sent and when.
Acceptance Criteria: Credit history list shows: VIP name · credit amount · issue date · expiry date · status (Active / Redeemed / Expired) | Filterable by status | Sortable by date | Export option for reporting

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to approve Bonus Bet Credit uploads before they are processed so that all credits meet commercial sign-off requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: Uploads pending approval appear in manager queue with 'Awaiting Approval' status | Manager can: Approve / Reject / Request Changes | Approved uploads trigger processing | Rejected uploads notify KAM with reason | Approval logged with timestamp

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to navigate forward and backward through upcoming birthday weeks so that I can plan outreach for VIPs whose birthdays are later in the month.
Acceptance Criteria: ‹ Prev and Next › controls allow stepping one week at a time | Date range label updates (e.g. Sep 16 – Sep 22) | Prev disabled when at current week | Navigator spans a rolling 30-day window | VIP list refreshes instantly on navigation with no page reload

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a single conversational interface in the console so that I can access all AI-powered insights and sub-agents without switching tools or tabs.
Acceptance Criteria: Agentforce Companion chat panel visible in 3rd column of console | Accessible to all account holders: VIP KAMs · KAM Managers · KAM Directors | Input field always visible | Companion response appears inline in chat thread | Session history persists within the tab | Empty state prompt encourages first message

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the companion to automatically detect what I'm asking and route to the right sub-agent so that I don't have to know which agent handles which topic.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion detects intent from natural language input | Routes to correct sub-agent: VIP Events Agent · VIP HPV Report Agent · BetExplain Agent · Promo Coach Agent | If intent is ambiguous companion asks a single clarifying question | Routing decision is transparent (companion indicates which agent it is invoking) | Fallback to general KAM knowledge base if no sub-agent matches

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the companion to know my full book of VIPs so that I can ask questions about my players without specifying IDs or navigating to individual records.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion has access to the logged-in KAM's full VIP book in the org | Can answer book-level queries: 'How is my book performing this week?' · 'Which of my VIPs hasn't been contacted in 30 days?' | VIP names resolve to Salesforce records | Companion respects record-level permissions (cannot surface VIPs outside KAM's book)

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want the companion to understand my team structure so that I can ask cross-KAM questions and get aggregated answers across my team's book.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion understands KAM → Manager → Director hierarchy from Salesforce org structure | Manager can query: 'Which of my KAMs has the most overdue contacts?' · 'Show me the team's WPC completion rate' | Director can query across multiple teams | Responses scoped to the requester's hierarchy level | Individual KAM queries return that KAM's data only

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to ask about upcoming events for my VIPs and get answers powered by the VIP Events Agent so that I can plan hospitality outreach from the chat interface.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion routes event-related queries to the VIP Events Agent | Example queries: 'What events are coming up I should invite Ethan Parker to?' · 'Who hasn't been invited to the Citi Field event?' | Response includes: event name · date · ticket availability · suggested VIPs to invite | Invite action available from response (P2)

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to ask for a VIP's high-player-value metrics and get a report from the HPV Report Agent so that I can review performance before a call without pulling a separate report.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion routes HPV metric queries to the VIP HPV Report Agent | Example queries: 'Show me Sophia's HPV metrics for the last 90 days' · 'Which of my Shield Select players are trending down?' | Response includes key HPV metrics in a structured summary | Time range parameterized from query (30d / 60d / 90d default) | Full report link provided for drill-down

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to ask the companion to explain a VIP's recent bets so that I can quickly understand their betting behavior and patterns before reaching out.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion routes bet-explanation queries to the BetExplain Agent | Example queries: 'Walk me through Luca's last 5 bets' · 'Why is Noah down so much this week?' | BetExplain Agent returns: bet type · stake · outcome · running P&L · notable patterns | Language is plain English — no raw odds or technical format | KAM can use this to inform a personalized outreach message

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to ask for a promotional recommendation for a specific VIP and get a response from the Promo Coach Agent so that I can offer the right incentive at the right time.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion routes promo-related queries to the appropriate Promo Coach Agent | Two Promo Coach Agent instances exist — routing logic to be confirmed in build (e.g. by segment or product line) | Example queries: 'What promo should I offer Isla Hayes?' · 'Is there a bonus I can give Ethan to retain him?' | Response includes: recommended offer type · amount · rationale · expiry recommendation | KAM can trigger offer from response (P2)

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to ask a single call-prep question and get a combined response drawing on multiple sub-agents so that I can prepare for a VIP call in seconds.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion recognizes call-prep intent and invokes multiple sub-agents in parallel | Example: 'Prepare me for a call with Noah Coleman' triggers: HPV Report + BetExplain + VIP Events + Promo Coach | Combined response structured as: Performance Summary · Recent Bet Activity · Upcoming Events · Recommended Promo | Response delivered as a single readable brief | Total response time target: <5 seconds

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want pre-built prompt buttons in the companion so that I can trigger common queries with one click instead of typing from scratch.
Acceptance Criteria: Row of quick-prompt buttons visible above the chat input field | Button labels TBD in build refinement — examples: 'Prep for a call' · 'Who needs contact today?' · 'Top promo opportunity' · 'Upcoming events' | Clicking a button populates the input and submits automatically | Buttons are contextual where possible (e.g. if a VIP record is open the prompt pre-fills their name) | Button set configurable per role in future iterations

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the companion to remember what we've discussed in the current session so that I can ask follow-up questions naturally without repeating context.
Acceptance Criteria: Companion retains conversation context within the session | Follow-up queries work without re-specifying the VIP: 'Tell me more about that bet' · 'What promo did you recommend for them?' | Context resets on new tab or session | Companion indicates context scope if needed ('Still referring to Luca Romano — is that right?')

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the companion to proactively surface urgent items when I open the console so that I don't miss critical actions at the start of my day.
Acceptance Criteria: On console load companion generates a brief proactive summary | Includes: overdue contacts · unactioned NBA items · VIPs with birthdays today · flagged RTA alerts | Summary is concise (3–5 bullets max) | KAM can dismiss or ask the companion to drill into any item | Proactive message clearly labeled as AI-generated

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to tell the companion that I made contact with a VIP and have it log the contact on the Salesforce record so that I don't have to navigate to the record to update it.
Acceptance Criteria: KAM can state: 'Log that I called Ethan Parker today' | Companion extracts: VIP name · contact type · date | Companion confirms details before submitting: 'Logging a Call for Ethan Parker today — confirm?' | On confirmation companion creates Activity record on VIP's Salesforce contact | Toast confirmation returned in chat | Post-MVP enhancement — not in initial release

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to ask the companion to send a follow-up email to a VIP so that I can execute outreach directly from the chat without switching to email.
Acceptance Criteria: KAM can request: 'Send a follow-up email to Sophia Novak about the upcoming event' | Companion drafts email using VIP context + relevant sub-agent data | Draft shown to KAM for review before send | KAM can edit draft inline | On confirm companion sends via Salesforce email action and logs activity | Post-MVP enhancement — requires Outlook/email integration

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to update a VIP's contact record fields from the companion so that routine CRM hygiene happens in the flow of conversation.
Acceptance Criteria: KAM can instruct: 'Mark Jordan Williams as contacted' · 'Update Isla's preferred contact channel to SMS' | Companion maps instruction to correct Salesforce field and record | Confirms action before writing: 'Updating Isla Hayes preferred contact channel to SMS — confirm?' | On confirm companion writes to Salesforce record and returns confirmation | Post-MVP enhancement — not in initial release

User Story: As a KAM Manager or Director I want my companion to surface team-level insights so that I can manage performance and identify coaching opportunities across my team.
Acceptance Criteria: Role is detected from Salesforce profile at login | KAM persona: access to own book only | Manager persona: access to own book + direct reports' books + team aggregates | Director persona: access to all teams in their division | Companion responses scoped accordingly — Manager cannot access KAM outside their team | Role-appropriate quick prompts shown (e.g. Manager sees 'Team contact health' · Director sees 'Division performance')

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the companion to route promo queries to the correct Promo Coach Agent instance so that I get segment- or product-appropriate promotional recommendations.
Acceptance Criteria: Two Promo Coach Agent instances are available | Routing logic between instances to be confirmed in build (segment-based / product-line-based / other) | Companion routes transparently — KAM does not need to know which instance is invoked | If routing is ambiguous companion asks one clarifying question before routing | OPEN QUESTION: confirm routing rule with Agentforce/platform team in Phase 1 scoping

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a No Contact alert card to fire only for my top 10% VIPs (by GGR for SBK / NGR for CAS) so that the NBA queue stays focused on highest-value relationship risk.
Acceptance Criteria: Card appears in NBA queue ONLY when: (1) VIP is in top 10% of KAM book by GGR (SBK) or NGR (CAS) AND (2) days since last activity exceeds cadence threshold (default 14d for top 10%) | VIPs outside top 10% tracked via Last Contact Tracker — not surfaced in NBA | Card does not fire if VIP is marked Do Not Surface or has a future touchpoint scheduled | Requires Book_GGR_Rank_Pct__c or equivalent field on Contact populated by nightly data sync

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want No Contact alert cards color-coded by days-since-contact severity so that I can instantly distinguish urgent accounts from routine follow-ups.
Acceptance Criteria: 15–20 days: Orange indicator | 21–30 days: Yellow indicator | 30+ days: Red indicator | Color applied to left border of NBA card and severity badge label | Default dashboard view filters to Red (30+ days) to reduce noise; KAM can expand to show all

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want contact thresholds configurable per product line so that Sportsbook VIPs (higher cadence) and Casino VIPs (lower cadence) are evaluated correctly.
Acceptance Criteria: Threshold config field on Contact/Account record (or custom metadata): SBK default=14d · CAS default=30d | Tier-based override takes precedence over product threshold when both apply | SA/admin configurable without code change

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the No Contact card to suggest a contact method and personalized talking points so that I can act on the alert immediately without researching the VIP separately.
Acceptance Criteria: Card includes AI-generated talking points referencing recent play activity and player preferences | Preferred contact channel recommended based on historical response patterns | Talking points generated by Agentforce using VIP record context | Phase 3 — requires Agentforce integration

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want an alert card to fire when one of my VIPs has contacted Customer Service or the HVP team in the last 24 hours so that I can proactively address the issue before the VIP escalates.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires when a Salesforce Case is created linked to a VIP Contact within the prior 24 hours | Card shows: VIP name · Case status · CS/HVP rep name · case summary · alert if multiple cases created in 24h | Requires CS and HVP teams to log all interactions as Salesforce Cases

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want open cases shown in red and closed cases in green so that I can immediately distinguish which interactions need my action.
Acceptance Criteria: Open Case card: Red left border and badge | Closed Case card: Green left border and badge | Color reflects Case Status field at time of card render | Card updates color if case status changes while card is displayed

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a closed-case card to include an AI-generated executive summary and sentiment flag so that I can quickly understand what happened without reading the full case notes.
Acceptance Criteria: Closed case card includes: AI summary of case interaction · sentiment label (Positive / Neutral / Negative) · recommended follow-up flag if issue type warrants it | Open case card includes: recommended messaging based on issue severity and client tier | Generated by Agentforce | Phase 3 — requires Agentforce integration

User Story: As a KAM Manager I want to be alerted when a VIP has multiple CS cases within a short window so that I can identify systemic issues or high-risk relationships.
Acceptance Criteria: Manager-level card fires when a single VIP generates 2+ cases in a 7-day window | Separate alert from individual KAM card | Includes: VIP name · case count · common issue category if detectable | P2 — requires case history aggregation

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want an immediate alert card when one of my VIPs records a single-day loss exceeding $100K so that I can respond with empathetic outreach before the VIP disengages.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires when single-day loss > $100K is recorded for a VIP in my book | Card shows: VIP name · FanDuel ID · Bet ID(s) · loss amount · wager details · individual vs cumulative indicator | Red severity | Requires Player Intelligence Engine / AWS Agent data available in Salesforce

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want an alert card when a VIP's loss significantly exceeds their normal wagering amount so that I can identify unusual behavior beyond just large absolute losses.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires when yesterday's handle loss exceeds 5x the VIP's L30 average wagered amount | Card shows: name · yesterday handle · L30 avg handle · number of bets · total loss · % variance from normal | Orange severity | Requires Player Intelligence Engine data

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the big loss card to suggest whether to contact immediately or wait 24 hours so that I approach the VIP at the right moment with the right tone.
Acceptance Criteria: Card includes AI recommendation: Immediate contact vs 24-hour cooling period based on player profile and loss type | Suggested messaging tone: empathetic / reassuring | RG flag if patterns indicate potential problem gambling — triggers welfare check flow | Phase 3 — requires Agentforce + PIE data

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a Show Some Love card to fire when a VIP has not received a KAM-issued bonus in 15+ days AND their RTC is below target so that I can proactively offer an incentive before play frequency drops.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires when: (1) Last KAM-issued bonus date > 15 days ago AND (2) Current RTC < Target RTC for that VIP | Card shows: VIP name · last bonus date · last bonus amount · L7 GGR · L7 Handle · days since bonus | Distinguishes KAM-issued generosity bonuses from system-generated promotions | Requires ACE bonus data + RTC data in Salesforce

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the Show Some Love card to recommend a specific bonus amount and type so that I can offer an appropriately calibrated incentive without manual research.
Acceptance Criteria: Card includes AI-recommended: bonus amount · bonus type (Bonus Bet / Event / Postal Gift) · rationale based on tier and play patterns | Lists unused promos with high conversion probability based on betting preferences | Expected ROI estimate for proposed bonus | Suggested personalized messaging referencing favorite sport / recent wins / upcoming events | Phase 3 — requires Agentforce + ACE integration

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to accept dismiss or defer a Show Some Love card so that the queue stays clean and my actions are tracked.
Acceptance Criteria: Accept: marks bonus as issued (or opens bonus flow) and removes card | Defer: snoozes card for configurable period (e.g. 3 days) | Dismiss: removes card with optional reason logged | All actions logged to VIP activity record for reporting | Applies to all NBA card types

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want an immediate alert on the day a VIP's status changes from Live to Non-Live so that I can initiate outreach or win-back action before the relationship cools.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires on day-of status change from Live to Non-Live | Card shows: VIP name · previous status · new status · change reason · description · date of change | Red severity for high-value VIPs | Requires real-time status change tracking in Salesforce

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want an alert 72 hours after a VIP returns to Live status so that I have time to evaluate their early activity before deciding on a bonus or re-engagement strategy.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires 72 hours after Non-Live → Live status change | Shows: VIP name · reactivation date · 72-hour play activity summary · recommended bonus consideration | 72-hour delay implemented via Scheduled Flow | Green / opportunity card styling

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the status change card to recommend a win-back or welcome-back strategy so that my outreach is personalized and timed correctly.
Acceptance Criteria: Live→Non-Live card includes: probable cause for status change · immediate outreach strategy recommendation for high-value VIPs · win-back campaign enrollment suggestion | Non-Live→Live card includes: optimal bonus based on 72h activity · welcome-back message template · predicted likelihood of sustained engagement | Phase 3 — requires Agentforce

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want an alert card when a VIP's weekly handle drops 20% or more week-over-week so that I can intervene before they appear on the WPC report.
Acceptance Criteria: Card fires when current week handle < prior week handle by 20%+ | Severity: 20–30%=Yellow · 31–40%=Orange · 40%+=Red | Card shows: VIP name · prior week handle · current week handle · % decrease · L30 avg handle · consecutive weeks of decline | Requires weekly handle data available in Salesforce / Data Cloud

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the decline card to explain likely reasons for the drop so that I can distinguish a temporary fluctuation from a genuine disengagement risk.
Acceptance Criteria: Card includes AI analysis: betting pattern review identifying external factors (e.g. 'No NFL games this week' · 'Favorite team on bye' · 'NBA season ended') | Predicts likelihood of continued decline vs temporary fluctuation | Highlights upcoming events matching player's betting preferences | Phase 3 — requires Agentforce + sports calendar data

User Story: As a KAM Manager or SA I want to configure WoW decline thresholds per product so that the alert sensitivity matches each segment's normal volatility.
Acceptance Criteria: Threshold configurable per product (SBK / CAS / DFS / FDR) in custom metadata or admin UI | Default: 20% across all products | SA/admin can adjust without code deploy | Threshold change takes effect on next weekly calculation run | Audit log of threshold changes

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the NBA queue to surface 4 prioritized scenario types for the MVP build so that I have actionable AI recommendations from day one of the prototype launch.
Acceptance Criteria: 4 MVP scenario cards displayed: (1) No Contact — red border, overdue cadence alert, [Log Contact] [Defer]; (2) CS Alert — red border, open Salesforce Case, [Contact VIP] [View Case] [Defer]; (3) Big Loss — red border, loss exceeds 5× avg, [Plan Outreach] [View Wagers] [Defer 24h]; (4) Bonus Opp — blue border, 15+ days no KAM bonus, RTC below target, [Issue Bonus] [Defer] | All 4 scenarios feasible at MVP without AWS Agent dependency | Phase 3 adds Agentforce AI layer

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a contextual action menu on each event row so that I can take the right action per event type without cluttering the card with multiple buttons.
Acceptance Criteria: Each event row shows ⋮ 3-dot menu button | Hosted events: Manage Event · View RSVPs · Send Reminder | Available/invited events: Invite VIP · View Event · Remove | Menu closes on outside click | One menu open at a time | Actions confirmed in refinement — current labels are prototyping placeholders

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a contextual action menu on each campaign row so that I can manage campaigns without inline buttons crowding the row.
Acceptance Criteria: Each campaign row shows ⋮ 3-dot menu button | Live/Scheduled campaigns: View Campaign · Add VIP · Duplicate | Draft campaigns: Edit Campaign · Preview · Delete Draft (destructive — red text) | Menu closes on outside click | Actions confirmed in refinement — current labels are prototyping placeholders

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want a contextual action menu on each birthday row so that I can send celebrations or access additional actions without a dedicated button per row.
Acceptance Criteria: Each birthday row shows ⋮ 3-dot menu button | Before send: Send Celebration · View Profile · Log Note | After send: View Profile · Log Note (Send Celebration removed) | Menu closes on outside click | Actions confirmed in refinement — current labels are prototyping placeholders

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want my top 10% highest-value VIPs (by GGR for SBK / NGR for CAS) surfaced at the top of the Last Contact Tracker so that I always ensure my most important player relationships are maintained first.
Acceptance Criteria: Tracker renders two labelled sections: (1) 'Priority Book — Top 10%' section header with GGR/NGR rank badge · VIP count · cadence metric; (2) 'Full Book' section header for remaining VIPs | Priority Book VIPs determined by Book_GGR_Rank_Pct__c ≤ 10 (SBK) or Book_NGR_Rank_Pct__c ≤ 10 (CAS) on the Contact record | Within each section: default sort most overdue first | NBA No Contact alerts fire only for Priority Book VIPs; Full Book managed exclusively via this tracker | Priority Book section and NBA No Contact share the same rank field — single data dependency
